row.notes: Vehicle physics section for SuspensionSystem: brake types (handbrake, temperature, damage brake loss), tyre types (mass, dimensions, grip) and punctures: PunctureWearMin/Max, Puncture Spring/Damping/Radius/Grip/Resistance multipliers, DebrisPunctureMin/MaxSpeed, DebrisPunctureProbabilityAtMin/MaxSpeed, DebrisPunctureInvulnerabilityPeriod, DebrisNextGenPunctureProbabilityMultiplier, PunctureSpeedTyreDamageRateSpline. Correction: this is the serialiser (component data vtable slot 3): it writes the section back as XML through the writer object's vtable (+0x28 begin element, +0x68 attribute, +0x78 end, +0x98 comment); the field list above is what it writes. The reader is slot 2 (Game_Read_VtfFloat by name, values stored XOR-obfuscated).
